question_text:
What must you reckon with when you see a hazard warning light flash?
With

options.text: - a school bus with children alighting

correct_answers.text: - a school bus with children alighting

comment: A driver must exercise special caution when perceiving a hazard light. Drivers of a car can use this for a variety of reasons. One example are regular buses that want to allow children to get in and out. Also, when a vehicle is towed, both the towed car and the towing vehicle will turn on their hazard light. A breakdown is also indicated by pressing the warning light and coming to a stop as soon as possible on the edge of the road.

question_text: What should you do if you see a vehicle with its hazard lights on?

options.text: I ready myself for hazards occurring suddenly
I continue driving just as before

correct_answers.text: I ready myself for hazards occurring suddenly

comment: If the hazard warning lights are switched on, there can be many reasons and causes. To be on the safe side, you should reduce your speed and drive past the vehicle with extra attention.

question_text: For which purposes is a horn allowed to be used outside built-up areas?
comment: You may announce your intention to overtake by horns or by flash light. You may also use a horn or flash light to warn other road uses and alert them of hazards. The operation of the horn as a call sign, without a specific danger situation, is not allowed.

question_text: For which purposes is a horn allowed to be used in built-up areas?
comment: In built-up areas, the horn may only be used by the driver as a warning signal in the event of a dangerous situation. As it would be an unnecessary noise nuisance, the use of the horn for greeting purposes or to indicate that you want to overtake, is inadmissible in built-up areas. Only outside of built-up areas, you may use the horn or flash light to announce an overtaking process.

question_text: What do you do in case of a breakdown in a tunnel?

options.text: Switch on the hazard warning lights
If possible, park the vehicle in an emergency bay
Let the engine run by way of precaution

correct_answers.text: Switch on the hazard warning lights
If possible, park the vehicle in an emergency bay

comment: In the tunnel, the alternatives for subsequent traffic are low. Therefore, if possible, stop in one of the marked emergency bays in the event of a breakdown. Switch on the hazard light on your car and switch off the engine due to the high risk of poisoning by exhaust gases in the tunnel.

question_text: You are driving in a tunnel and approach the end of a traffic jam. What do you do?

options.text: Switch on the hazard warning lights
Make a U-turn and leave the tunnel
At the end of the traffic jam, switch off the engine and leave the vehicle

correct_answers.text: Switch on the hazard warning lights

comment: If you recognize a traffic jam in front of you, it is important to immediately press the hazard light to warn the drivers behind you of the coming situation. This way, they can react better to the situation. During traffic jams, the car driver should stop the engine but not leave the car. Turning in the tunnel is not allowed.
